messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — onsite candidate Liam Park arriving Tue 2026-04-07 10:00am PT. Main asks: loaner laptop for coding exercise, one-day parking pass, vegetarian lunch, and a greeter at reception. Can we confirm?

Luke Garcia: I'll add him to the panel calendar. Which room do we want to reserve for a quiet coding setup?

Maya Chen: Quiet room with monitor and wired ethernet would be ideal. Preferable to keep coding task on loaner to avoid local env issues.

Jess Walsh: @Maya Chen added request to the calendar invite (panel+zoom). Room suggestion: 4A-Quiet (near 4th floor kitchens). I'll book if IT approves ethernet + monitor.

IT Ops: 4A-Quiet is fine. We can prep a loaner Dell XPS with VSCode + python3.11 and the corp wifi cert installed. Anyone need a specific image?

Maya Chen: Standard interview image is fine. Please enable Docker and grant ephemeral sudo for the session.

IT Ops: Noted. I'll create loaner ticket. Command for tracking:```/equip request --type loaner-laptop --model xps --user "Liam Park" --days 1 --notes "docker, sudo-ephemeral, wired-ethernet"```

PeopleOps Bot: Badge/visitor pass requested for Liam Park. Request ID: VIS-20260407-88. ETA: will print at reception and hold under his name.

Anika Patel: I'll be the greeter on Tue at 9:50am, can meet Liam at the lobby. Also need to confirm dietary restriction: vegetarian (Maya noted). Any allergies?

Maya Chen: Candidate is vegetarian, no allergies reported. Please order a boxed lunch (vegetarian, no nuts).

Jess Walsh: Parking pass — we have a 1-day guest permit code: GUEST-RED-0426. I can forward directions + parking map in the invite. Do we want to reimburse ride share if he flies in?

Luke Garcia: He indicated local travel, but if he ends up flying, we reimburse up to $150 for one-way. I'll add reimbursement note to the invite and sync with finance.

PeopleOps Bot: Loaner ticket created: EQUIP-7891. Pickup scheduled Mon 4/6 at 4pm from IT dropbox. Assigned tech: @IT Ops.

IT Ops: I'll image the laptop Monday and put a sticky with the ticket ID and temporary password. Please remind candidate to bring photo ID for reception.

Maya Chen: Quick checklist for the panel — can everyone confirm they can join in person? Mike will be remote; Zoom link included.

Luke Garcia: In-person: Luke, Jess, Anika. Mike remote via Zoom. Confirmed.

Anika Patel: I'll meet and sign him in. If anything runs late, please ping me on mobile.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — last item: accessibility note: candidate asked for a quiet space and low-scent environment. Please keep the room ventilated and avoid strong-smelling foods nearby.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: send candidate arrival details + parking map + downtown transit options 24 hours before arrival.

Jess Walsh: I'll send final invite with all attachments today. :::end of thread:::
